semiconductor_relevance: High — Lam Research is a leading global supplier of wafer fabrication equipment and services, essential for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Lam Research India Pvt Ltd provides innovative wafer fabrication equipment and services to the semiconductor industry, enabling the production of smaller, faster, and more power-efficient devices. Their offerings include advanced plasma etch, thin film deposition, and wafer cleaning solutions, which are critical for front-end wafer processing and advanced packaging applications.

regional_presence.India: Lam Research has a presence in India to support its global customer base and meet the dynamic needs of the semiconductor industry.
